name: +1 Speed Gym Escape! 💪
desc:
💪 Welcome To +1 Speed Gym Escape !

❓ HOW TO PLAY: ❓
💪 You're stuck in the world's most dangerous gym - can you escape?
🏃‍♂️ Run through chaotic gyms, dodge flying dumbbells, and run through angry bodybuilders!
💰 Earn money by escaping each stage!
📊 Upgrade your speed and stamina to outrun the gym's traps!

⚡ Get faster and stronger with each run and become the best at escaping this chaotic gym!
🏆 Climb leaderboards to show you're the best!

👍 Like & Favorite the game to support the development!
🔔 Join our group for exclusive pets!
